purpose: Home-page hero: a tag, an all-caps headline, a supporting sentence, two CTAs and a 16:9 promo video that plays a muted looping teaser until the visitor presses play, then swaps to the full video.

variants.name: teaser-playing
variants.description: Default: muted, looping teaser video with poster; a play button overlay centred on it (15% of video width, 10% from lg).

variants.name: started
variants.description: After click: the full video mounts with autoplay and native controls (unmuted, no loop) and the play overlay fades out and unmounts.

headline.note: Rendered as h1, uppercase, black-weight heading font.

teaserVideo.note: Muted looping mp4 shown before play.

fullVideo.note: Played with controls after the play button is pressed.

behaviour.note: The video area is a plain <video> pair, not a third-party embed. The play button is an inline-SVG triangle (PlayTriangle) on a solid gray-10 rectangle; it is the only overlay.
The teaser has no autoplay attribute; play() is called on mount and failures are swallowed.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Proposal only: the code has no prefers-reduced-motion handling. Pattern is the closest fit in the closed enum: the play overlay exits with opacity 1 to 0 over 300ms easeOut (cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1)) on click; the play button hover is opacity .8 over 200ms. The teaser loop itself is video playback, not a UI transition.

changes.change: top padding steps 40 / 48 (md) / 56 (xl); tag bottom margin 20 / 24 (sm) / 32 (lg)
video is placed second in the grid, directly after the tag and before the headline text
headline spans full width (12 cols at md, 22 from col 2 at lg); subheadline narrows to 8 cols at md, 16 at lg, 14 at xl
CTAs sit side by side, capped at 400px wide; below sm they stack full width
play button shrinks from 15% to 10% of video width
